messages.subject: qvalue cutoff not working well
parts:
Dear Methylkit team-

Thank you for a great tool.

I am running into an issue. Please see below.

My code is

#mydiff_25p_ALL_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated
myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth,num.cores=16,slim=TRUE,difference=25,overdispersion="MN")
write.table(myDiff, file="mydiff_25p_ALL_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated.1000_1000.txt", sep="\t", quote=F)

#mydiff_25p_q001_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated
myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth,num.cores=16,slim=TRUE,difference=25,qvalue.cutoff=0.01,overdispersion="MN")
write.table(myDiff, file="mydiff_25p_q001_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated.1000_1000.txt", sep="\t", quote=F)

Issue: When I do a wc on the two files above, they are same.


622518 mydiff_25p_ALL_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated.200_100.txt
622518 mydiff_25p_q001_SLIM_overdispersion_F-test_annotated.200_100.txt


Shouldn't they be same? And how come the qvalues are still coming into the file, even though the third value is greater than 0.4?
